_doc: What a Regular is like as a manager (core/deed_choices.gd). `order` is the list a Regular is dealt from by the letters of their id, unless `assign` names them. Keys: bonus (takings multiplier; the five average about the old flat 1.15), use (stock a day), shield (share of a bad day's loss they avoid, negative makes it worse), boom (extra from a good day), carry (days the till keeps filling when you are away), style (which answer they give when the monthly matter is left to them: safe, bold, frugal), cost (what their answers cost, as a share), rep (reputation they build a month). Knowing the town (+0.03), the goods (+0.02) and favour 5 (+0.02) come on top, in the code.

careful.label: careful
careful.blurb: Never takes a chance with the books, and a bad day hardly shows. Nothing exciting happens on their watch, which is the idea.

showman.label: a bit of a showman
showman.blurb: Makes the most of a good day and the most of a bad one too. Answers every letter with a flourish, and the flourish costs.

thrifty.label: thrifty
thrifty.blurb: Wastes nothing, reuses everything, and answers every problem with the cheapest sensible thing. Takes a little less than the others, and keeps a lot more.

charmer.label: a charmer
charmer.blurb: Knows every regular by name and their order by heart. The place gets a better name month by month, without anyone planning it.

steady.label: steady as a rock
steady.blurb: Turns up on time, locks up properly and keeps the till filling a month longer than anyone else would while you are off in another country.
